description: This role will allow you to do every operation in CyberRangeCZ Platform Training module.
This role will allow you to manage, test, import and export training definitions and assign organizers to beta testing group in CyberRangeCZ Platform Training module.
This role will allow you to prepare training instances from training definitions and manage them, restart sandbox instances and view situational awareness in CyberRangeCZ Platform Training module.
This role will allow you to access training run and play a training in CyberRangeCZ Platform Training module.
This role marks newly registered users as waiting for CyberGoatz MVP access approval.
This role allows users to enter the CyberGoatz learner platform.
